subtitle.zh: 1990, 68000 + Z80 双 CPU 街机 / 家用机架构
subtitle.en: 1990, dual-CPU 68000 + Z80 arcade / home console architecture

description.zh:
Neo Geo 由三条互不相通的总线组成：68000 主总线（程序、工作 RAM、I/O）、Z80 音频总线（M1 ROM、YM2610）和 LSPC 图形总线（VRAM、C/S ROM）。

没有帧缓冲：LSPC 逐扫描线从卡带 C ROM 取 tile，经 NEO-B1 行缓冲合成后查 palette RAM 输出。没有 DMA：68000 通过 3 个 MMIO 寄存器逐 word 写 VRAM。两颗 CPU 之间只有一个 8-bit sound latch 和一根 NMI 线。

详细说明见 docs/arch/neogeo.md。
description.en:
The Neo Geo consists of three mutually isolated buses: the 68000 main bus (program, work RAM, I/O), the Z80 audio bus (M1 ROM, YM2610) and the LSPC graphics bus (VRAM, C/S ROM).

There is no framebuffer: the LSPC fetches tiles from the cartridge C ROM scanline by scanline, composites them in the NEO-B1 line buffers and outputs them through palette RAM lookup. There is no DMA: the 68000 writes VRAM one word at a time through 3 MMIO registers. The only links between the two CPUs are one 8-bit sound latch and a single NMI line.

See docs/arch/neogeo.md for details.

details.zh:
主 CPU。运行游戏逻辑，每帧在 VBlank 中断里读输入、更新 VRAM 中的 sprite 控制块（SCB1-4）与 fix map、写 palette RAM、向 Z80 发送音效命令并踢 watchdog。

它看不到任何图形或采样数据：C/S/V ROM 都不在它的地址空间内。VRAM 也只能通过 $3C0000 的 REG_VRAMADDR / REG_VRAMRW / REG_VRAMMOD 三个寄存器间接访问。

中断：IRQ1 = VBlank（向量 $64），IRQ2 = LSPC 定时器（$68），IRQ3 = 冷启动。全部由 LSPC 产生，需写 REG_IRQACK 应答。
details.en:
Main CPU. Runs the game logic; every frame, in the VBlank interrupt, it reads inputs, updates the sprite control blocks (SCB1-4) and fix map in VRAM, writes palette RAM, sends sound commands to the Z80 and kicks the watchdog.

It cannot see any graphics or sample data: the C/S/V ROMs are all outside its address space. VRAM, too, is only accessible indirectly through the three registers REG_VRAMADDR / REG_VRAMRW / REG_VRAMMOD at $3C0000.

Interrupts: IRQ1 = VBlank (vector $64), IRQ2 = LSPC timer ($68), IRQ3 = cold boot. All are generated by the LSPC and must be acknowledged by writing REG_IRQACK.

props.value: IRQ1 VBL, IRQ2 timer, IRQ3 reset

details.zh:
摇杆、按键、投币、DIP 开关、Start/Select、记忆卡状态等输入寄存器，以及 LED、投币计数器、卡槽选择等输出寄存器。

REG_P1CNT $300000 / REG_P2CNT $340000：P1/P2 摇杆与 ABCD 键（低有效）。
REG_DIPSW $300001：读 DIP 开关；写 = 踢 watchdog。
REG_STATUS_A $320001：投币、Service、RTC。
REG_STATUS_B $380000：Start/Select、AES/MVS 标志。
REG_POUTPUT $380001：手柄端口输出。
details.en:
Input registers for joysticks, buttons, coins, DIP switches, Start/Select, memory card status, etc., plus output registers for LEDs, coin counters, slot selection, etc.

REG_P1CNT $300000 / REG_P2CNT $340000: P1/P2 joystick and ABCD buttons (active low).
REG_DIPSW $300001: read DIP switches; write = kick watchdog.
REG_STATUS_A $320001: coins, Service, RTC.
REG_STATUS_B $380000: Start/Select, AES/MVS flag.
REG_POUTPUT $380001: joypad port outputs.

details.zh:
68000 与 Z80 之间唯一的通信通道：两个 8-bit 锁存器（mailbox）。

68000 写 REG_SOUND ($320000) → 命令锁存，并向 Z80 发 NMI（若 Z80 已通过 port $08 使能）。Z80 读 port $00 取命令并应答 NMI；写 port $00 把命令锁存清零。

Z80 写 port $0C → 应答锁存；68000 读 REG_SOUND 得到应答，不产生中断，只能轮询。约定：Z80 回显命令并置 bit 7 表示已处理。

BIOS 约定的命令：$01 准备切槽（必须应答）、$02 eyecatcher 音乐、$03 Z80 软复位。
details.en:
The only communication channel between the 68000 and the Z80: two 8-bit latches (mailboxes).

The 68000 writes REG_SOUND ($320000) → command latch, and an NMI is sent to the Z80 (if the Z80 has enabled it via port $08). The Z80 reads port $00 to fetch the command and acknowledge the NMI; writing port $00 clears the command latch.

The Z80 writes port $0C → reply latch; the 68000 reads REG_SOUND to get the reply. No interrupt is raised, so it can only poll. Convention: the Z80 echoes the command with bit 7 set to signal it has been handled.

BIOS-defined commands: $01 prepare for slot switch (must be acknowledged), $02 eyecatcher music, $03 Z80 soft reset.

details.zh:
音频 CPU。独立运行卡带 M1 ROM 中的音效驱动，不参与游戏逻辑。

内存：$0000-$7FFF M1 ROM 固定段；$8000/$C000/$E000/$F000 四个 bank 窗口（16/8/4/2 KiB）；$F800-$FFFF 2 KiB RAM。

Bankswitch 通过读 port $08-$0B 完成，bank 号放在地址总线高 8 位（B 寄存器）——NEO-ZMC 为省引脚而设计的技巧。

中断：NMI ($0066) 来自 68000 的 sound latch；IRQ ($0038) 来自 YM2610 定时器。
details.en:
Audio CPU. Independently runs the sound driver in the cartridge M1 ROM; it takes no part in game logic.

Memory: $0000-$7FFF fixed M1 ROM region; four bank windows at $8000/$C000/$E000/$F000 (16/8/4/2 KiB); $F800-$FFFF 2 KiB RAM.

Bankswitching is done by reading ports $08-$0B, with the bank number placed on the upper 8 bits of the address bus (the B register) -- a trick NEO-ZMC uses to save pins.

Interrupts: NMI ($0066) from the 68000's sound latch; IRQ ($0038) from the YM2610 timers.

details.zh:
Z80 音效驱动与乐谱数据。位于卡带 CHA board（与 C/S ROM 同板），通过 NEO-ZMC / NEO-ZMC2 做 bank 切换，最大 4 MiB。

主板上另有 SM1 ROM（BIOS 自带的音效驱动），REG_BRDFIX / REG_CRTFIX 决定 Z80 执行哪一个。
details.en:
Z80 sound driver and music data. Located on the cartridge CHA board (same board as the C/S ROMs), bank-switched via NEO-ZMC / NEO-ZMC2, up to 4 MiB.

The motherboard also has an SM1 ROM (the BIOS's own sound driver); REG_BRDFIX / REG_CRTFIX select which one the Z80 executes.

details.zh:
音源芯片。FM 4 通道（4-op）、SSG 3 通道、ADPCM-A 6 通道（固定约 18.5 kHz，12-bit 播放）、ADPCM-B 1 通道（1.85-55.5 kHz 可变，16-bit 播放）。

Z80 通过 port $04-$07 写寄存器。ADPCM 采样由 YM2610 自己经独立的 ADPCM 总线从 V ROM 读取，Z80 不搬运数据。

FM/ADPCM 数字输出经 YM3016 DAC；SSG 为模拟直出；两个定时器可向 Z80 发 IRQ。
details.en:
Sound chip. 4 FM channels (4-op), 3 SSG channels, 6 ADPCM-A channels (fixed ~18.5 kHz, 12-bit playback), 1 ADPCM-B channel (variable 1.85-55.5 kHz, 16-bit playback).

The Z80 writes its registers through ports $04-$07. ADPCM samples are fetched by the YM2610 itself from V ROM over a separate ADPCM bus; the Z80 does not move the data.

FM/ADPCM digital output goes through the YM3016 DAC; SSG is output directly as analog; two timers can raise IRQs to the Z80.

details.zh:
视频控制器。LSPC 根据当前扫描线与 VRAM 内容生成 C ROM / S ROM / L0 ROM 地址，输出同步信号，产生全部 3 个 68000 中断，并仲裁 68000 对 VRAM 的访问。

NEO-B1 持有 4 个行缓冲（两对交替），把串行化后的 sprite 像素与 fix 像素写入行缓冲，再逐像素输出 12-bit palette RAM 地址。它还包含 watchdog。

每帧 381 个 sprite，每行最多 96 个；sprite 是 16 px 宽、最高 32 tile (512 px) 的竖条，支持 shrink 和 sticky-bit 链接；fix layer 40x28 个 8x8 tile 永远在最上层。没有帧缓冲：每条扫描线实时合成。
details.en:
Video controller. Based on the current scanline and VRAM contents, the LSPC generates C ROM / S ROM / L0 ROM addresses, outputs sync signals, generates all 3 68000 interrupts and arbitrates 68000 access to VRAM.

NEO-B1 holds 4 line buffers (two alternating pairs); it writes the serialized sprite pixels and fix pixels into the line buffers, then outputs a 12-bit palette RAM address per pixel. It also contains the watchdog.

381 sprites per frame, up to 96 per line; a sprite is a vertical strip 16 px wide and up to 32 tiles (512 px) tall, with support for shrink and sticky-bit chaining; the fix layer of 40x28 8x8 tiles is always on top. No framebuffer: every scanline is composited in real time.

details.zh:
只存属性和索引，不存像素。两块 SRAM 接在 LSPC 的两条独立总线上，可并行读取。

Lower (64 KiB)：$0000-$6FFF SCB1 sprite tile maps（448 x 64 words：tile 编号、palette、翻转、自动动画）；$7000-$74FF fix map（40x32，列主序）；$7500-$7FFF 扩展。

Upper (4 KiB)：$8000 SCB2 shrink；$8200 SCB3 Y / sticky / 高度；$8400 SCB4 X；$8600/$8680 偶/奇扫描线 active sprite list（LSPC 自己写）。

68000 只能通过 REG_VRAMADDR/RW/MOD 访问；跨 $8000 边界要重设地址。
details.en:
Holds only attributes and indices, not pixels. Two SRAMs sit on two separate LSPC buses and can be read in parallel.

Lower (64 KiB): $0000-$6FFF SCB1 sprite tile maps (448 x 64 words: tile number, palette, flip, auto-animation); $7000-$74FF fix map (40x32, column-major); $7500-$7FFF extension.

Upper (4 KiB): $8000 SCB2 shrink; $8200 SCB3 Y / sticky / height; $8400 SCB4 X; $8600/$8680 even/odd scanline active sprite lists (written by the LSPC itself).

The 68000 can only access it through REG_VRAMADDR/RW/MOD; crossing the $8000 boundary requires resetting the address.

details.zh:
颜色查找表。2 个 bank（REG_PALBANK0/1 切换），每 bank 256 palette x 16 色 x 16-bit = 8 KiB，映射在 $400000-$401FFF。

颜色字：bit 15 dark bit，bits 14:12 R0/G0/B0，bits 11:8 R，7:4 G，3:0 B。每 palette 颜色 0 透明；$400000 必须为 $8000（黑，视频基准）；$401FFE 为 backdrop 色。

NEO-B1 在 68000 与行缓冲之间切换 palette RAM 地址总线，68000 优先，活动显示期间写入会有轻微 glitch。
details.en:
Color lookup table. 2 banks (switched by REG_PALBANK0/1), each 256 palettes x 16 colors x 16-bit = 8 KiB, mapped at $400000-$401FFF.

Color word: bit 15 dark bit, bits 14:12 R0/G0/B0, bits 11:8 R, 7:4 G, 3:0 B. Color 0 of each palette is transparent; $400000 must be $8000 (black, the video reference); $401FFE is the backdrop color.

NEO-B1 switches the palette RAM address bus between the 68000 and the line buffers, with the 68000 taking priority; writes during active display cause minor glitches.

details.zh:
palette RAM 的 16-bit 颜色输出被两个 8-bit 寄存器锁存，送入电阻网络 DAC，与 LSPC 的 SYNC 一起形成 15 kHz RGB（MVS 经 JAMMA 到机柜显示器，AES 经 AV 接口）。

REG_SHADOW 可让整屏压暗一级。
details.en:
The 16-bit color output of palette RAM is latched by two 8-bit registers and fed to a resistor-network DAC; together with the LSPC's SYNC it forms 15 kHz RGB (MVS goes through JAMMA to the cabinet monitor, AES through the AV connector).

REG_SHADOW can darken the whole screen by one step.

details.zh:
ADPCM 采样数据，位于卡带 PROG board。早期卡带 ADPCM-A 与 ADPCM-B 分别放在 V1 / V2 ROM，后期用 PCM 复用芯片共用。

YM2610 直接通过自己的 ADPCM 总线读取（Z80 只写起止地址），这是 Neo Geo 里唯一由外设主动取数据的通路。ADPCM-A 样本 256 B-1 MiB，不能跨 1 MiB 页；ADPCM-B 最大 16 MiB。
details.en:
ADPCM sample data on the cartridge PROG board. Early cartridges put ADPCM-A and ADPCM-B in separate V1 / V2 ROMs; later ones share them through a PCM multiplexer chip.

The YM2610 reads it directly over its own ADPCM bus (the Z80 only writes start/end addresses); this is the only path in the Neo Geo where a peripheral fetches data on its own. ADPCM-A samples are 256 B-1 MiB and cannot cross a 1 MiB page; ADPCM-B is up to 16 MiB.

details.zh: 音效驱动的工作内存，仅 2 KiB。命令 $01（准备切槽）要求 Z80 把一个等待循环复制到这里执行，因为切槽后 M1 ROM 会换掉。
details.en: Working memory of the sound driver, only 2 KiB. Command $01 (prepare for slot switch) requires the Z80 to copy a wait loop here and run it, because the M1 ROM is swapped out after the slot switch.

details.zh:
Sprite 图形。每 tile 16x16 px 4 bpp = 128 B，按右上/右下/左上/左下四个 8x8 块存放。ROM 成对：奇数号 (C1, C3...) 存 bitplane 0/1，偶数号 (C2, C4...) 存 bitplane 2/3，一次地址取 32 bit = 8 px。

LSPC 经 24-bit P bus 输出地址，CHA board 上的 NEO-273 锁存 (PK1)，NEO-ZMC2 / PRO-CT0 / NEO-CMC 把 32 bit 串行化成 16 个像素送 NEO-B1。访问时间必须 < 250 ns。

20-bit tile 编号 → 最多 1M tile (128 MiB)。68000 完全不可见。
details.en:
Sprite graphics. Each tile is 16x16 px 4 bpp = 128 B, stored as four 8x8 blocks in the order top-right/bottom-right/top-left/bottom-left. ROMs come in pairs: odd-numbered ones (C1, C3...) hold bitplanes 0/1, even-numbered ones (C2, C4...) hold bitplanes 2/3; one address fetches 32 bits = 8 px.

The LSPC outputs the address on the 24-bit P bus, NEO-273 on the CHA board latches it (PK1), and NEO-ZMC2 / PRO-CT0 / NEO-CMC serialize the 32 bits into 16 pixels sent to NEO-B1. Access time must be < 250 ns.

20-bit tile number → up to 1M tiles (128 MiB). Completely invisible to the 68000.

details.zh:
Fix layer 图形：8x8 px 4 bpp = 32 B / tile，4096 tile = 128 KiB（NEO-CMC 可 bank 扩展）。LSPC 经 P bus 输出地址（PK2 锁存），数据经 8-bit FIX 总线进 NEO-B1。

主板上另有 SFIX ROM（BIOS 字体），REG_BRDFIX / REG_CRTFIX 切换。
details.en:
Fix layer graphics: 8x8 px 4 bpp = 32 B / tile, 4096 tiles = 128 KiB (NEO-CMC allows bank expansion). The LSPC outputs the address on the P bus (latched by PK2), and data enters NEO-B1 over the 8-bit FIX bus.

The motherboard also has an SFIX ROM (BIOS font), selected via REG_BRDFIX / REG_CRTFIX.

details.zh:
68000 程序与数据，位于卡带 PROG board。$000000-$0FFFFF 为向量表与固定段；$200000-$2FFFFF 为第二窗口，>2 MiB 的游戏在该范围写 word 让 PROG board 上的锁存器切换 A20/A21（1 MiB bank）。

ROMWAIT / PWAIT 可为慢 ROM 插入等待周期。
details.en:
68000 program and data on the cartridge PROG board. $000000-$0FFFFF holds the vector table and fixed region; $200000-$2FFFFF is a second window: games > 2 MiB write a word in this range so a latch on the PROG board switches A20/A21 (1 MiB banks).

ROMWAIT / PWAIT can insert wait states for slow ROMs.

details.zh:
68000 工作内存。$100000-$10F2FF 用户区；$10F300-$10FFFF 由 BIOS 保留（系统变量、BIOS 调用参数）；$110000-$1FFFFF 镜像。

游戏通常在这里维护 sprite 的影子副本，每帧 VBL 时再批量写入 VRAM。
details.en:
68000 working memory. $100000-$10F2FF user area; $10F300-$10FFFF reserved by the BIOS (system variables, BIOS call parameters); $110000-$1FFFFF mirror.

Games typically keep a shadow copy of the sprites here and write it to VRAM in bulk during VBL each frame.

details.zh:
主板 BIOS：上电自检、卡槽管理、投币/积分、系统菜单、记忆卡、通用子程序（如 sprite 工具）。REG_SWPBIOS / REG_SWPROM 决定异常向量表来自 BIOS 还是卡带。

配套 SFIX（字体）与 SM1（音效驱动）ROM 也在主板上。
details.en:
Motherboard BIOS: power-on self test, slot management, coins/credits, system menu, memory card, common subroutines (e.g. sprite utilities). REG_SWPBIOS / REG_SWPROM select whether the exception vector table comes from the BIOS or the cartridge.

The companion SFIX (font) and SM1 (sound driver) ROMs are also on the motherboard.

details.zh: 电池备份 SRAM，仅 MVS 街机有：保存投币统计、高分、机台设置。REG_SRAMLOCK / REG_SRAMUNLOCK 控制写保护。AES 用记忆卡 ($800000) 代替。
details.en: Battery-backed SRAM, MVS arcade only: stores coin statistics, high scores and machine settings. REG_SRAMLOCK / REG_SRAMUNLOCK control write protection. The AES uses a memory card ($800000) instead.

title.zh: 68000 -> Z80 音效命令（sound latch + NMI + 应答）
title.en: 68000 -> Z80 sound command (sound latch + NMI + reply)

description.zh: 演示两颗 CPU 之间唯一的通信通道：一个 8-bit 命令锁存、一根 NMI 线、一个 8-bit 应答锁存。68000 侧有中断可发、无中断可收，只能轮询应答。
description.en: Shows the only communication channel between the two CPUs: one 8-bit command latch, one NMI line and one 8-bit reply latch. The 68000 side can send an interrupt but cannot receive one, so it can only poll for the reply.

text.zh: 游戏逻辑决定播放某个音效（例如命中音），68000 准备命令字节 cmd（含义由卡带的 Z80 驱动定义；$01/$02/$03 为 BIOS 保留）。
text.en: The game logic decides to play a sound effect (e.g. a hit sound); the 68000 prepares a command byte cmd (its meaning is defined by the cartridge's Z80 driver; $01/$02/$03 are reserved by the BIOS).

text.zh: 68000 执行 move.b #cmd, REG_SOUND ($320000)。NEO-C1 把字节存入命令锁存。锁存深度只有 1 字节：若上一条命令还没被 Z80 取走就会被覆盖。
text.en: The 68000 executes move.b #cmd, REG_SOUND ($320000). NEO-C1 stores the byte in the command latch. The latch is only 1 byte deep: if the Z80 has not yet taken the previous command, it is overwritten.

text.zh: 锁存写入同时拉低 Z80 的 /NMI（前提是 Z80 已用 out ($08) 使能 NMI）。Z80 无论在做什么都会跳到 $0066。
text.en: The latch write simultaneously pulls the Z80's /NMI low (provided the Z80 has enabled NMI with out ($08)). Whatever the Z80 is doing, it jumps to $0066.

text.zh: NMI 处理程序执行 in a,($00) 读出命令字节，这个读操作同时应答 NMI。可选地 out ($00),a 把锁存清零，以便区分“新命令”和“旧命令”。
text.en: The NMI handler executes in a,($00) to read the command byte; this read also acknowledges the NMI. Optionally, out ($00),a clears the latch so that a "new command" can be told apart from an "old command".

text.zh: Z80 查 M1 ROM 中的命令表，通过 port $04-$07 向 YM2610 写寄存器（设置 ADPCM-A 起止地址并触发，或开始 FM 音序）。YM2610 随后自己从 V ROM 读采样。
text.en: The Z80 looks up the command table in M1 ROM and writes YM2610 registers through ports $04-$07 (setting ADPCM-A start/end addresses and triggering, or starting an FM sequence). The YM2610 then reads the samples from V ROM by itself.

text.zh: Z80 执行 out ($0C),a 写应答锁存，约定值为 cmd | $80（回显并置 bit 7）。这一步不会中断 68000。
text.en: The Z80 executes out ($0C),a to write the reply latch, conventionally with cmd | $80 (echo with bit 7 set). This step does not interrupt the 68000.

text.zh: 68000 在需要时读 REG_SOUND 轮询应答。多数游戏不等待，只在下一帧 VBL 前发下一条命令；BIOS 的 $01 命令则必须等到应答，否则显示 Z80 ERROR。
text.en: The 68000 reads REG_SOUND when needed to poll for the reply. Most games don't wait and just send the next command before the next frame's VBL; the BIOS $01 command, however, must wait for the reply, otherwise Z80 ERROR is shown.

title.zh: 一帧的渲染：VBL -> 写 VRAM -> LSPC 逐扫描线合成 -> DAC
title.en: Rendering a frame: VBL -> write VRAM -> LSPC per-scanline compositing -> DAC

description.zh: Neo Geo 没有帧缓冲。68000 在 VBlank 里更新 VRAM 中的 sprite 控制块，LSPC 在之后的每条扫描线实时从 C ROM / S ROM 取 tile，经 NEO-B1 行缓冲与 palette RAM 输出到 DAC。
description.en: The Neo Geo has no framebuffer. The 68000 updates the sprite control blocks in VRAM during VBlank; afterwards, on every scanline the LSPC fetches tiles from C ROM / S ROM in real time and outputs them to the DAC through the NEO-B1 line buffers and palette RAM.

text.zh: 上一帧最后一条可见行结束，LSPC 进入 VBlank 并拉 IRQ1。68000 进入 VBL 处理程序，首先写 REG_DIPSW 踢 watchdog，并写 REG_IRQACK bit 2 应答中断。
text.en: The last visible line of the previous frame ends; the LSPC enters VBlank and raises IRQ1. The 68000 enters the VBL handler, first writing REG_DIPSW to kick the watchdog and writing bit 2 of REG_IRQACK to acknowledge the interrupt.

text.zh: 读取 REG_P1CNT / REG_P2CNT / REG_STATUS_B 获取输入；在 Work RAM 中运行游戏逻辑，更新角色、背景滚动位置，得到本帧每个 sprite 的 X/Y/tile/palette。
text.en: Read REG_P1CNT / REG_P2CNT / REG_STATUS_B for input; run the game logic in Work RAM, updating characters and background scroll positions to get each sprite's X/Y/tile/palette for this frame.

text.zh: 68000 写 REG_VRAMADDR = $8200 (SCB3)、REG_VRAMMOD = 1，然后连续向 REG_VRAMRW 写每个 sprite 的 Y/sticky/高度；再切到 $8400 写 X、$8000 写 shrink、$0000+ 写 SCB1 tile map。没有 DMA，全部逐 word 写，并遵守 12/16 周期间隔。
text.en: The 68000 writes REG_VRAMADDR = $8200 (SCB3) and REG_VRAMMOD = 1, then writes each sprite's Y/sticky/height to REG_VRAMRW in sequence; it then switches to $8400 to write X, $8000 for shrink and $0000+ for the SCB1 tile maps. There is no DMA: everything is written word by word, respecting the 12/16-cycle spacing.

text.zh: 若需要，68000 还更新 palette RAM（$400000+，VBlank 期间写不会 glitch）并向 REG_SOUND 发送本帧的音效命令。然后退出 VBL 处理程序，等待下一帧。
text.en: If needed, the 68000 also updates palette RAM ($400000+; writes during VBlank don't glitch) and sends this frame's sound commands to REG_SOUND. It then exits the VBL handler and waits for the next frame.

text.zh: 可见区开始。对每条扫描线 n，LSPC 在前一行期间扫描快 VRAM 中的 SCB3[0..380]，把 Y 窗口覆盖行 n 的 sprite 编号写入 $8600/$8680 的 active sprite list——最多 96 个，超出的被丢弃。
text.en: The visible area begins. For each scanline n, during the previous line the LSPC scans SCB3[0..380] in fast VRAM and writes the numbers of sprites whose Y window covers line n into the active sprite list at $8600/$8680 -- at most 96; any beyond that are dropped.

text.zh: 对 list 中每个 sprite：由 (n - Y, 垂直 shrink) 经 L0 ROM 得到 tile 索引与 tile 内行号；读慢 VRAM 的 SCB1 取 20-bit tile 编号、palette、flip；在 P bus 上输出 C ROM 地址，NEO-273 锁存，一对 C ROM 返回 32 bit (8 px x 4 bitplane)，NEO-ZMC2 串行化成像素并按水平 shrink 抽列。
text.en: For each sprite in the list: (n - Y, vertical shrink) goes through L0 ROM to give the tile index and row within the tile; SCB1 in slow VRAM is read for the 20-bit tile number, palette and flip; the C ROM address is output on the P bus and latched by NEO-273; a pair of C ROMs returns 32 bits (8 px x 4 bitplanes), which NEO-ZMC2 serializes into pixels, dropping columns according to horizontal shrink.

text.zh: NEO-B1 把不透明的 sprite 像素 (palette<<4 | index) 写入当前行缓冲，后画的覆盖先画的（编号大者优先）。随后 LSPC 读 fix map 该行 40 个 word，从 S ROM 取 8x8 tile 的一行，写入行缓冲——fix 永远在最上层。
text.en: NEO-B1 writes opaque sprite pixels (palette<<4 | index) into the current line buffer; later-drawn pixels overwrite earlier ones (higher sprite number wins). The LSPC then reads the 40 words of the fix map for this row, fetches one row of each 8x8 tile from S ROM and writes it into the line buffer -- the fix layer is always on top.

text.zh: 行缓冲成对交替：上一行填好的缓冲以 6 MHz 逐像素输出 12-bit 地址到 palette RAM，取回 16-bit 颜色 (dark + 5/5/5 RGB)，锁存后送 DAC 形成 RGB。未被覆盖的像素保持 $FFF，显示 backdrop 色 ($401FFE)。224 条可见行后回到步骤 1。
text.en: Line buffers alternate in pairs: the buffer filled on the previous line outputs 12-bit addresses to palette RAM pixel by pixel at 6 MHz, getting back 16-bit colors (dark + 5/5/5 RGB), which are latched and sent to the DAC to form RGB. Uncovered pixels remain $FFF and show the backdrop color ($401FFE). After 224 visible lines, return to step 1.

title.zh: 卡带 ROM 读取路径：PROG board 与 CHA board 的并行总线
title.en: Cartridge ROM read paths: parallel buses of the PROG and CHA boards

description.zh: 卡带由两块 PCB 组成，经两个独立连接器挂在不同总线上：PROG board (P ROM, V ROM) 接 68000 总线与 YM2610 ADPCM 总线；CHA board (C ROM, S ROM, M1 ROM) 接 LSPC 的 P bus、FIX 总线与 Z80 总线。四个读取者可以同时访问各自的 ROM，互不争用。
description.en: A cartridge consists of two PCBs attached to different buses through two separate connectors: the PROG board (P ROM, V ROM) connects to the 68000 bus and the YM2610 ADPCM bus; the CHA board (C ROM, S ROM, M1 ROM) connects to the LSPC's P bus, the FIX bus and the Z80 bus. The four readers can access their own ROMs simultaneously without contention.

text.zh: 68000 取指：地址 $000000-$0FFFFF 经主板地址译码 (NEO-E0) 选中 PROG 连接器上的 P1 ROM，16-bit 数据回到 68000。ROMWAIT 决定是否插入 1 个等待周期。
text.en: 68000 instruction fetch: addresses $000000-$0FFFFF pass through the motherboard address decoder (NEO-E0) to select the P1 ROM on the PROG connector, and 16-bit data returns to the 68000. ROMWAIT determines whether 1 wait state is inserted.

text.zh: 访问 $200000-$2FFFFF (PORT 区) 选中 P2 ROM。>2 MiB 的游戏先在该范围写一个 word，PROG board 上的 74LS74 锁存 D0/D1 作为 P2 ROM 的 A20/A21，实现 1 MiB 为单位的 bankswitch。
text.en: Accessing $200000-$2FFFFF (PORT area) selects the P2 ROM. Games > 2 MiB first write a word in this range; a 74LS74 on the PROG board latches D0/D1 as A20/A21 of the P2 ROM, implementing bankswitching in 1 MiB units.

text.zh: 与此同时 Z80 从 CHA board 的 M1 ROM 取指：$0000-$7FFF 直接映射前 32 KiB；访问 $8000+ 窗口时，NEO-ZMC(2) 用之前 in a,(c) 读端口 $08-$0B 时捕获的 bank 号拼出 MA11-MA21 地址。
text.en: Meanwhile the Z80 fetches instructions from the M1 ROM on the CHA board: $0000-$7FFF maps directly to the first 32 KiB; when accessing the $8000+ windows, NEO-ZMC(2) forms the MA11-MA21 address from the bank numbers captured earlier when in a,(c) read ports $08-$0B.

text.zh: YM2610 的 ADPCM-A/B 通道按自己的节奏（约 18.5 kHz / Delta-N）在 ADPCM 总线上输出 24-bit 地址，从 PROG board 的 V ROM 读 4-bit 采样。Z80 与 68000 都不参与数据搬运。
text.en: The YM2610's ADPCM-A/B channels, at their own pace (~18.5 kHz / Delta-N), output 24-bit addresses on the ADPCM bus to read 4-bit samples from the V ROM on the PROG board. Neither the Z80 nor the 68000 takes part in moving the data.

text.zh: LSPC 在每条扫描线上通过 24-bit 复用 P bus 输出 C ROM 地址 (tile 编号 x 128 B + 行偏移)，CHA board 的 NEO-273 用 PK1 锁存；一对 C ROM 并行输出 32 bit（C1: bitplane 0/1，C2: bitplane 2/3），NEO-ZMC2 以 12 MHz 串行化成 8 个像素 + 透明标志送 NEO-B1。要求 ROM 访问时间 < 250 ns。
text.en: On each scanline the LSPC outputs C ROM addresses (tile number x 128 B + row offset) on the 24-bit multiplexed P bus, latched by NEO-273 on the CHA board with PK1; a pair of C ROMs outputs 32 bits in parallel (C1: bitplanes 0/1, C2: bitplanes 2/3), and NEO-ZMC2 serializes them at 12 MHz into 8 pixels + transparency flags sent to NEO-B1. ROM access time must be < 250 ns.

text.zh: 同一 P bus 分时输出 S ROM 地址 (PK2 锁存)，S ROM 经 8-bit FIX 总线返回 fix tile 的一行像素。REG_BRDFIX / REG_CRTFIX 决定这条路径指向卡带 S ROM 还是主板 SFIX ROM。
text.en: The same P bus time-multiplexes S ROM addresses (latched by PK2), and the S ROM returns one row of fix tile pixels over the 8-bit FIX bus. REG_BRDFIX / REG_CRTFIX determine whether this path points to the cartridge S ROM or the motherboard SFIX ROM.
